purpose: Dental clinician lingo mapped to brief patient-friendly meanings.

constraints.patient_meaning_style: plain language, non-alarming, one sentence or phrase
constraints.intended_use: live chairside transcription and patient education

entries.patient_meaning: Standard numbers used to identify each adult tooth.

The lower jaw or lower set of teeth.
